title: App settings
appearanceDescription: Choose how Markweft looks on this device.
themeModeDescription: Follow the system or use a fixed appearance.
appLanguageDescription: System uses the language selected in macOS.
privacyWorkspaceDescription: Control what is shown on the welcome screen.
showRecentPathsDescription: Display full local file paths in Recent books.
safetyDescription: Protect destructive actions while editing books.
confirmDestructiveDescription: Ask before deleting chapters or history versions.
bookSettingsNote: Book-specific page, typography and publication settings remain inside each .mdw book.
